thread:
incident-bot: [SEV2] Spike in model errors across eu-west and us-east - automatic smart-routing fallbacks detected :rotating_light:

ryan-ops: acked. seeing 5xxs + toolcall failures. attaching short log sample.

maya-sre: I'm on it. paging roster: ryan -> maya -> oliver.

ryan-ops: logs: ```
2026-03-15T09:07:12Z service=router request_id=abcd1234 route=chat model_variant=vicuna-q4_0 tool_call=true status=500 err="tool_call_not_supported"
2026-03-15T09:07:12Z service=router request_id=abcd1235 route=chat model_variant=vicuna-q4_0 fallback_from=fp16 reason=variant_mismatch
2026-03-15T09:07:13Z service=router request_id=abcd1236 route=chat model_variant=vicuna-fp16 downstream=eu-west-2 status=200
```

oliver-ml: hm. looks like smart-routing routed a bunch of traffic to the q4 quantized variant that doesn't support tool calling. That will cause tool invocations to 500.

jade-support: Customer-facing note: multiple enterprise customers reporting automated retries and failed webhooks. CS tickets: CS-19324, CS-19325. Impact: some customers' payment webhook handlers failing -> retries flooding them.

sam-platform: Is this a region fallback event? any recent deploys to routing policy?

ryan-ops: yes. we observed capacity pressure in eu-west, routing policy moved traffic to us-east and to smaller GPU pools. The smart router then tried to pick quantized variants to reduce cost and filled them up. The compatibility matrix incorrectly listed q4 variant as toolcall=true for some models.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20260315-7. Pager duty: @maya-sre -> acknowledged by maya-sre.

maya-sre: quick mitigation plan: 1) disable smart routing policy coupling (flip feature flag) 2) enable circuit breaker on tool_call path so requests to incompatible variants fail fast and fall back to fp16 3) pin routing for impacted customers to stable fp16 variants 4) patch compatibility matrix.

ryan-ops: patching plan: run command to flip the flag: ```sh
# disable variant auto-promotion
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://controlplane/api/flags/smart-routing/disable
```

oliver-ml: also need a fix in the model compatibility table: q4 variants for vicuna-2.1 and lumina-7b were incorrectly marked toolcall=true for sequence lengths > 2048. Actual supported: toolcall=false for q4 at lengths > 2048.

ryan-ops: executing disable now.

incident-bot: controlplane: smart-routing disabled by ryan-ops at 2026-03-15T09:12:01Z.

ryan-ops: rolling out circuit breaker rule: ```json
{
  "matcher": "request.tool_call == true && model.variant.quantized == true",
  "action": "reject_fast",
  "status": 409,
  "message": "Incompatible variant for tool calling"
}
```

jade-support: informing impacted customers. drafted message: "We're investigating intermittent tool call failures — routing changes are being applied to restore stable variants. No user data exposed. More updates in 30m."

customer-ops: we saw spikes of retries ~3x baseline between 09:06-09:14 UTC. Some customers throttled us back which reduced overall downstream noise.

oliver-ml: quick telemetry check: compatibility_check metrics show false positives in matrix ingestion job at 02:00 UTC. The CSV ingestion incorrectly defaulted toolcall to true when quantization flag present.

maya-sre: rolling hotfix to ingestion job to treat q4 variants as toolcall=false unless explicitly annotated. Also creating migration to backfill matrix entries.

sam-platform: can we put an emergency patch to routing to prefer same-arch fp16 fallback before cross-region quantized? That will reduce cross-region oscillation.

ryan-ops: good call. adjusting routing priority: prefer same-region compatible variant -> same-region fallback -> cross-region fp16 -> cross-region quantized. Applying now.

incident-bot: routing policy updated by ryan-ops at 2026-03-15T09:19:40Z.

ryan-ops: monitoring errors... 5xxs dropping from ~420/s to ~18/s over 5 mins. toolcall failures 500->409 as circuit breaker ejected incompatible variants.

jade-support: customers updated. CS tickets escalated to priority-high. A few customers asked for capacity reservation while they complete retries.

oliver-ml: started backfill job for compatibility matrix. ETA ~45m to finish and propagate.

maya-sre: we should do a retro: root cause = compatibility matrix ingestion bug + routing priority logic that favored lower-cost quantized variants cross-region under capacity pressure. Secondary cause = missing guardrails for toolcall path.

ryan-ops: next actions list: 
- complete backfill + validation (oliver)
- add unit tests to ingestion job for toolcall/quant edgecases (oliver)
- add routing policy unit test for prefer-same-region (sam)
- add alert for sudden increase in fallback_to_quantized metric (maya)
- document customer impact and postmortem (jade)

customer-ops: any permanent mitigation options for customers who rely on toolcalling?

oliver-ml: we added a new customer-level pin: "force_variant=fp16" that customers or SRE can set for critical owners. Recommend offering as short-term SRE service and include in Dedicated onboarding.

incident-bot: INC-20260315-7 moved to mitigated at 2026-03-15T10:01:12Z.

maya-sre: monitoring for 2 hours. keeping smart-routing disabled until backfill + tests deployed.

ryan-ops: final notes for now — impact window 09:05-09:20 UTC, some customers experienced tool_call 500s and webhook retries. No data leakage. Follow-up: postmortem scheduled 2026-03-16 16:00 UTC.

jade-support: tagging CS tickets done. I'll prepare customer-facing incident summary after postmortem draft.

oliver-ml: I'll attach the ingestion diff and CI tests in the postmortem.

maya-sre: thanks team. reassigning oncall back to normal rotations in 2h unless alerts spike.

ryan-ops: thanks all, closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
